description: Freight Activity from Transport Starter Data Kits is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Climate Compatible Growth (CCG). Historical freight activity data for selected countries in Africa, Asia, and South America. Coverage: Algeria, Angola, Benin, Botswana, Burkina Faso, Burundi. The portal files it under the publisher Climate Compatible Growth (CCG). Its tags are Freight, Freight activity. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-01-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
